Strand: Numbers 1.5 Multiplication (10 lessons) By the end of the sub strand, the learne
Topic 1.6: Division
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Division, part of Numbers 1.5 Multiplication (10 lessons) By the end of the sub strand, the learne in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three MATHEMATICAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can you represent division as repeated subtraction? 2. How can we use the multiplication table to work out division questions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Division together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: learner discusses division as repeated subtraction of numbers.

• Learning to learn: learner discovers the connection between repeated subtraction and division.

Values:
• Social justice: learner shares objects equitably by repeatedly taking away from a group a specific number of objects at a

time until all are finished.

• Unity: learner plays videos games involving division with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Critical thinking: learner models division as repeated subtraction of numbers up to 50 by 4 and 5 using counters.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate skills used in discussion to listening and speaking skills in English and Kiswahili Language
